obligations.summary: Notified bodies shall inform the notifying authority of any Union technical documentation assessment certificates, supplements, and quality management system approvals issued in accordance with Annex VII.

Notified bodies shall inform the notifying authority of any refusal, restriction, suspension, or withdrawal of a Union technical documentation assessment certificate or quality management system approval issued under Annex VII.
Notified bodies shall inform the notifying authority of any circumstances affecting the scope of or conditions for their notification.
Notified bodies shall inform the notifying authority of any request for information received from market surveillance authorities regarding conformity assessment activities.

Notified bodies shall inform the notifying authority, upon request, of conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of their notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting.
Each notified body shall inform other notified bodies of quality management system approvals it has refused, suspended, or withdrawn, and upon request, of quality system approvals it has issued.

Each notified body shall inform other notified bodies of Union technical documentation assessment certificates or supplements it has refused, withdrawn, suspended, or restricted, and upon request, of certificates and supplements it has issued.

Each notified body shall provide other notified bodies carrying out similar conformity assessment activities for the same types of AI systems with relevant information on negative conformity assessment results, and upon request, positive results.
Notified bodies shall safeguard the confidentiality of information they obtain in accordance with Article 78.
